artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: ingest(root, document, client=None, open_func=open): for every file of every RESOLVED folder (resolution taken FRESH from backlog.build(), never a typed list), opens the library path with "rb" only, computes sha256, and lands it via store.bronze_put under form_b_object(report_id, safe_name) -- report_id is the sha256's first 16 hex so a changed file lands under a NEW key and the prior object stays. Placeholder state is recorded from library.census() BEFORE the read; a read failure is counted in read_failed and never skipped silently. --write measured live: run 1 (cold, some placeholders unhydrated) gave resolved_folders 33 files_in_resolved 123 stored 123 (put_performed 123 existed 0) read_failed 0, placeholders_before 24 hydrated_ok 24, unresolved_files 228 in 59 folders. Run 2 (immediately after) gave the SAME population but put_performed 0 existed 123 and placeholders_before 0 (the first run had already hydrated every OneDrive placeholder it touched) -- proving bronze's never-overwrite live, not just in the stub. --verify measured live: objects 123 files 123 match 123 mismatch 0, elapsed_s 15.313 (well inside the 120s bound, 16-worker thread pool).

8 tests under the package poison with a stub S3 client (never real boto3.client): SAME BYTES TWICE (existed True, put_performed False on the second ingest); CHANGED BYTES (new report_id/key, prior object's bytes untouched); NON-ASCII NAME (stored as <report_id><ext>, metadata source-relpath percent-encodes the real name); UNRESOLVED IS NOT STORED (an Unresolved-Co file produces no put and is surfaced in unresolved_files); READ MODE (every open() of a library path recorded "rb", none other); VERIFY CAN FAIL (a one-byte-corrupted stored object reports match False with a mismatch detail, and the same object with its bytes restored reports match True) -- a verifier that cannot report a mismatch proves nothing. Plus 2 pure-helper tests (content_type_for, safe_object_name).

The run record from the final live --write, carrying the integer keys files_in_resolved (123), stored (123), read_failed (0) and unresolved_files (228), plus resolved_folders, put_performed/existed, placeholders_before/hydrated_ok and the unresolved_folders list (59 folder names).
